errors.name: bad-override
errors.description:
Class member `ToTensorV2.apply` overrides parent class `BasicTransform` in an inconsistent manner
  `ToTensorV2.apply` has type `(self: ToTensorV2, img: ImageType, **params: Any) -> Tensor`, which is not assignable to `(self: ToTensorV2, img: ImageType, *args: Any, **params: Any) -> ImageType`, the type of `BasicTransform.apply`
  Signature mismatch:
  expected: def apply(self: ToTensorV2, img: ImageType, *args: Any, **params: Any) -> ImageType: ...
                                                         ^^^^^^^^^^^^ parameters      ^^^^^^^^^ return type
  found:    def apply(self: ToTensorV2, img: ImageType, **params: Any) -> Tensor: ...
                                                         ^ parameters     ^^^^^^ return type
errors.concise_description: Class member `ToTensorV2.apply` overrides parent class `BasicTransform` in an inconsistent manner
